defaultPrompt: Use spec-design to preserve separate Requirements and Specification identities: authorized Why and observable What.
Use program-design to define structural How against this specification.
Use practices-manage-agents to choose a helper's role, form and model, then commission, monitor, or assess its work.
Use orchestrator-design to run this through one design cycle before planning: Requirements, Specification, Program Design, Verification Design, and their independent review.
Use orchestrator-implementation-goal to carry this implementation goal through planning, implementation, proof, review, and PR readiness.
Use plan-implementation to create one repo-grounded proof-bearing plan from this reviewed design set.
Use implement-plan to execute this ready canonical plan at its immutable path, current meaning, and pr-ready-unmerged delivery context.
Use implementation-review to independently review this implementation and proof without editing.
Use spec-program-review to independently review this Specification, this Program Design, or this four-document design set (Requirements, Specification, Program Design, Verification Design).
Use spec-handoff to package this design for another agent.
Use plan-improve-repo to audit this repo and write executable improvement plans.
Use implementation-pr-wrapup to finish this PR.
